entries.explanation: A stratovolcano of 3,776 metres, last in eruption in 1707.

factCards.text: Magma and lava are the same material at different addresses: it is called magma below ground and lava once it has erupted.
factCards.sourceTitle: USGS Volcano Hazards Program — Volcano Glossary

factCards.text: Mount Fuji rises 3,776 metres, making it the highest mountain in Japan; its most recent eruption began in 1707.
A lahar can travel far beyond the volcano itself, since meltwater and rain carry loose ash down river valleys.
